## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes in `web/` and `server/`, and `npm run build` in `web/` / pasan los tests y el build
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (`docs/en`, `docs/es`) / Documentación actualizada si cambia el comportamiento
- [ ] No real personal data in code, tests or screenshots (plates, names, invoices, tokens) / Sin datos personales reales
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are pinned and justified below / Dependencias nuevas fijadas y justificadas
